{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the revenue column
print("Original revenue sample:")
print(sales['revenue'].head(10))

# Check for the QA orders with revenue 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Remove QA orders
sales_clean = sales[sales['revenue'] != '999999.99']

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
sales_clean['revenue_float'] = sales_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = sales_clean[sales_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders
display(completed_orders['revenue_float'].mean())

# Output the result as a float
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders: {completed_orders['revenue_float'].mean()}")"}
